defs.def: to move backwards or forwards or from side to side while hanging from a fixed point; to make sth do this （使）摆动，摇摆，摇荡

ex.s: As I rushed outdoors to empty the wastepaper baskets, the door swung shut behind me.
ex.t: 当我匆忙跑到户外去倒废纸篓时，门在我身后砰地关上了。

ex.s: There’s not enough room to swing a cat.
ex.t: 也没有足够的空间摆动一只猫。

ex.s: Of course, Disneyland also has many exciting rides to amuse you, from enormous swinging ships to scary freefall drops.
ex.t: 当然，迪士尼乐园也有许多令人兴奋的游乐设施来供你消遣，从巨大的摇摆船到可怕的自由落体。

ex.s: Ellie 24 Junior doctor (1 picture) There’s not enough room to swing a cat in my small apartment, so I don’t cook very often.
ex.t: Ellie 24初级医生（ 1张照片）我的小公寓没有足够的空间荡猫，所以我不经常做饭。

defs.def: to move from one place to another by holding sth that is fixed and pulling yourself along, up, etc. 纵身跃向；荡向；悬吊到
to move or make sth move with a wide curved movement （使）弧线运动，转弯，转动
to turn or change direction suddenly; to make sth do this （使）突然转向，突然转身

ex.s: After making sure that David could run if he wanted, I turned to find him coming towards me, his small body rocking from side to side as he swung his feet forward.
ex.t: 确保David想跑就能跑之后，我转身发现他正朝我走来，小小的身体前后摇晃着向前迈步。

ex.s: After making sure that David could run if he wanted, I turned to find him coming towards me, his small body rocking from side to side as he swung his feet forward.
ex.t: 确保David想跑就能跑之后，我转身发现他正朝我走来，小小的身体前后摇晃着向前迈步。

defs.def: to try to hit sb/sth （挥动某物）朝 … 打去
to change or make sb/sth change from one opinion, mood, etc. to another （使）改变（意见、情绪等）
to succeed in getting or achieving sth, sometimes in a slightly dishonest way （有时略微不正当地）获得，搞到，办成
to have a strong rhythm 有强劲的节奏；节奏感强

ex.s: Actually, I do not have to wait until I go to university to swing into action as there will be a workshop in my city next month, which I am hoping to attend.
ex.t: 实际上，我不必等到我上大学后再采取行动，因为下个月将在我的城市举办一个讲习班，我希望参加讲习班。

defs.def: if a party, etc. is swinging, there are a lot of people there having a good time 热闹；令人开心
a swinging movement or rhythm 摆动；挥动；转动；强劲节奏

ex.s: They are good at swinging their legs.

defs.def: a change from one opinion or situation to another; the amount by which sth changes 改变；改变的程度
a seat for swinging on, hung from above on ropes or chains 秋千
the swinging movement you make with your arms and body when you hit the ball in the game of golf 挥杆动作

ex.s: A common dance sequence could be waiata tira (warm-up song), whakaeke (entrance song), waiata-ā-ringa (action song), haka (challenge), pou (old-style singing), poi (ball-swinging), and whakawātea (closing song).
ex.t: 常见的舞蹈序列可以是waiata tira(暖歌)、whakaeke(热歌)、waiata-ā-ringa(动作曲)、haka(挑战曲)、pu(老式歌唱)、poi(旋转球)和whakawātea(关闭曲)。

defs.def: a type of jazz with a smooth rhythm, played especially by big dance bands in the 1930s 摇摆乐（流行于 20 世纪 30 年代）
a quick journey, especially one made by a politician, in which sb visits several different places in a short time （尤指从政者在多处逗留的）短期快速行程
to be lively and enjoyable 聚会或活动
to have a strong rhythm 音乐
